Point 5 implementation. Boundaries: edition state/export contracts, app save/restore, CLI/export orchestration. AT-23/24 minimal scope; depends on joined interaction, not general chronology, interviews, cohort tools or the full analysis-table pipeline.

Acceptance:
1. Save a versioned state referencing exact artifact digests/schema versions, qualified semantic selection/focus, projection/fixed cut, supplied mapping/policy, independent horizons/cursors and viewport. State is not a content-access grant; omit sensitive text/media/paths by default. Ordinary fixture-only hover is not persisted.
2. Reopen against the same permitted artifacts restores semantic state. Geometry may adapt; pixel equality is claimed only under pinned metrics/backend. Changed/missing source, recall, mapping or capability causes a useful refusal, never guessed offset/ordinal rebinding. Preserve a defined no-selection state.
3. Export the selected view with an accessible twin, producer-generated exact permitted scientific subset and receipt linking all IDs, source support, values, normalization and decision/measure policy. Do not scrape SVG or recompute scientific values. Restricted text cannot hide in inline JSON, labels, DOM/accessibility or bundled files.
4. An independent small Python or Scala consumer of the exported subset reproduces expected selected IDs/values/support from the producer fixture and saved state. M1 promises semantic replay; it does not deliver the broader G2 analysis exchange/readout system or calibrated conclusions.
5. Include a second precomputed mapping-policy artifact when testing policy selection; changing it is explicit and recorded. The comparison may use synthetic/reconstruction records; no reference estimator is required or impersonated.

Falsifiers: keep title/IDs but change bytes; export a different policy or subset; renormalize cropped cells; leak a denied string; reopen with foreign recall. Each fails while exact replay succeeds.

Evidence: exact producer/consumer/Intaglio/grakern revisions, actual overrides distinguished from declared pins; compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS; existing shell smoke and tests implemented for the current slice; the complete M1 browser journey is required only by the final acceptance ticket. Provider adoption may close after decode/compile, exact-pin build and existing-consumer regression checks while loader, interaction and export remain unimplemented. Preserve warnings as findings and make changed code warning-clean. Browser automation uses the project browser, ownership audits before/after, and closes owned processes. Add a discriminating failure injection for each new boundary. Preserve static no-JavaScript publication as a separate contract. Test names for new M1 courts are specifications until implemented; never claim them run from ticket creation.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force.
Bounded child work (reuse these tickets rather than reimplementing inside this parent):
- bd-01M35A7BPV353CV9JY3472S65G — [M1] Save and restore versioned identity-bound investigations
- bd-01M35A7BX3KHZ2KBWHF9Y78P5G — [M1] Export the same selected record through figure, twin and subset
This issue retains integrated acceptance/original broader scope. Its new local dependency chain covers child delivery; child closure alone is not proof of the parent acceptance. Do not add a child dependency back to this parent.
